functions: no pwm – LEDC reaches every GPIO through the matrix, which edakit's slice model cannot express (see verified.open)
adc.range_v [0, 2.5]: the effective range at ATTEN3 (ESP32-C3 Series Datasheet table 5-6) on the ADC1 pins – assumption: the firmware uses ATTEN3; IO5 (ADC2) without adc window
i_core_a 0.35 A: the 802.11b TX peak of table 6-4 as the upper bound
gpio_i_max_a 0.028 A: IOL typ 28 mA at VOL 0.495 V and PAD_DRIVER = 3 (table 6-3) – assumption: no absolute maximum per pin given
pin v_max_v and gpio_v_max_v 3.6 V: VIH max VDD + 0.3 V at VDD 3.3 V (table 6-3)
GPIO2 strap high: the datasheet recommends a pull-up although GPIO2 does not decide the boot mode (table 4-3 note 2) – LVL.boot asks for it
